annotations.title: Pendle V2 Logit Curve & PT TWAP Slippage Analyzer

description: Use this tool when a user asks about Pendle V2 fixed yields (PT/YT), wants to compare Spot Implied APY against the 15-minute geometric PT Oracle TWAP, or needs to simulate how a large PT trade impacts the logit AMM curve (`scalarRoot`, `lnFeeRateRoot`).

marketAddress.description: Pendle V2 Market contract address (defaults to flagship PT-sUSDe market)

simPtTradeSize.description: Simulated PT trade size to calculate logit curve price impact (default: 1000000)

name: analyze_pendle_v2_logit_curve_and_twap
title: Pendle V2 Logit Curve & PT TWAP Slippage Analyzer
